## Introduction

Write 2–6 short paragraphs. This is **prose-first**.
Set context. Define the problem. Tell the learner what changes after this lesson.

<Aside type="tip">
Keep it friendly and table-minded. Avoid “academic tone”.
</Aside>

## Lesson

### Topic heading

Write the lesson body as **text**, with examples.
Use bullets only when they clarify structure (not as a substitute for writing).

### Another topic

More prose. Add images/videos if they *teach*, not for decoration.

> Tip: prefer a few strong examples over many weak ones.
